darkMode.verdict: Morph hand-off is consistent in dark mode: clone and real sheet are the identical hardcoded #F7F6F4, so nothing pops at T3. The light slab against a near-black page is a design decision in DetailView/TransitionLayer, not a morph defect - reported, not changed.
